title: Lipschitz Stability Estimates for Master Fields with Measure-Variable Regularity in Mean Field Games
summary: In this paper, we investigate the Lipschitz stability of the master field and its functional derivative with respect to the measure variable for the master equation in mean field games. A key novelty of this work is the derivation of a nonlocal parabolic partial differential equation governing the functional measure derivative along a characteristic measure flow. Based on this equation, we establish a Carleman estimate for the difference of the measure derivatives associated with two sufficiently regular classical solutions.
